_doc: Shrink-only ratchet for the canonical radon_raw_nloc block band (1031.9, p95, corpus revision 1). Cutover 2026-08-01, seeded at the modules already over the band when module-sloc-cap-radon was repointed off its own invented <=1000 cap onto the one canonical threshold table (.gzkit/rules/complexity-thresholds.md § Invariant). NEVER add an entry to silence a fresh violation — that is the laundering ADR-0.0.73 Boundary Invariant #8 forbids. An entry records the ceiling a module may never exceed again; a module that drops under the band must surrender its entry, which is what makes the list shrink-only. Enforced by .gzkit/chores/module-sloc-cap-radon/check_module_size.py.
